manifest_meta.title: Photography exhibition opens at town hall

paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: WLD-0021 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Photography exhibition opens at town hall SOURCE_NAME: Midgard Times SOURCE_TYPE: news RELIABILITY: 2 PUB_DATE: 2024-08-05 PUB_TIME: 11:45 COUNTRY: Ravik SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Photography exhibition opens at town hall
[P1] An exhibition of photographs taken in Ravik's hill villages has opened at the town hall. The images show work, celebrations and everyday scenes recorded over the past five years.

[P2] The photographer said the project began as a personal record and grew into a wider portrait of the area. Several people featured in the pictures attended the opening and helped identify places that have since changed.
[P3] The exhibition is free and runs until the end of the month. A book of the photographs is available at the front desk, and a portion of the money will go to a local advice service.
